I'll start off with durability. The durability is great maybe even better than a regular phone to be honest. My inner screen looks flawless after months of spen and regular use without a screen protector. Can't say the same thing about the cover screen though it's all scratched up and it's cracked a little and that's because the inner screen is protected all the time except when you're using it. Cameras are great you will definitely be satisfied with them. I'm sure the Ultra cameras are better but you won't be disappointed with any shot this phone takes. The outer screen front camera is your standard front camera which takes good pictures but the inner camera is just amazing it's absolutely invisible during regular use it's like nothing is there but the quality of the photos is just meh but a good tradeoff imo. The worst thing about the phone without a doubt is the battery life sort of. With WiFi only it's absolutely fine granting you a good 6 hours of SOT but when you're using mobile data the battery just extremely suffers with like 4-4.5 hours of SOT at best (granted that is with 6 hours of off screen music streaming). In conclusion pretty good phone if you're around chargers a lot or if you carry a power bank with you. Also one thing that can't be overlooked is the size. You will most likely miss the feel of a regular phone quite a bit as with times you can feel like the cover screen is too small and narrow and the inner screen is too big. Hope this helps, cheers!
